title.en: Yunus (AS): A Call from the Darkness

status: draft: to be checked by a scholar before public release

say.en: A prophet of Allah, alone, in the deepest darkness a person could ever know. And a call he made from there, that the Quran has kept for us.
say.hi: Allah ka ek paighambar, akela, aise andhere mein jahan se koi wapas nahi aata. Aur wahan se ek pukaar, jo Quran ne hamare liye mehfooz kar di.

say.en: The Quran says: And indeed, Yunus was among the messengers.
say.hi: Quran kehta hai: aur yaqeenan Yunus bhi rasoolon mein se the.

say.en: He called his people to Allah. But he left them in anger, thinking that Allah would not hold him to account.
say.hi: Unhone apni qaum ko Allah ki taraf bulaya. Phir woh narazgi mein unhein chhod kar chale gaye, yeh samajh kar ke Allah unpar giraft nahi karega.

say.en: He boarded a fully loaded ship. Lots were drawn, and the lot fell on him.
say.hi: Woh ek bhari hui kashti mein sawar hue. Qura daala gaya, aur naam unhi ka nikla.

say.en: Then the great fish swallowed him, while he blamed himself.
say.hi: Phir ek badi machli ne unhein nigal liya, aur woh khud ko malamat kar rahe the.

heading.en: NIGHT. SEA. | *THE BELLY OF THE FISH.*

say.en: The darkness of the night. The darkness of the sea. The darkness inside the fish. And from within these darknesses, he called out.
say.hi: Raat ka andhera. Samundar ka andhera. Machli ke pet ka andhera. Aur in andheron ke beech se, unhone pukaara.

say.en: La ilaha illa anta, subhanaka, inni kuntu minaz-zalimin. There is no god but You. Glory be to You. Indeed, I have been among the wrongdoers.
say.hi: La ilaha illa anta, subhanaka, inni kuntu minaz-zalimin. Tere siwa koi mabood nahi, Tu paak hai, beshak main hi zaalimon mein se tha.

heading.en: SO WE ANSWERED HIM | *AND SAVED HIM*
heading.hi: TO HUMNE UNKI SUNI | *AUR NAJAAT DI*

say.en: So We answered him and saved him from the distress. And this is how We save the believers.
say.hi: To humne unki dua qubool ki aur unhein gham se najaat di. Aur isi tarah hum imaan walon ko bachate hain.

say.en: Had he not been of those who glorify Allah, he would have stayed in its belly until the Day of Resurrection.
say.hi: Agar woh tasbeeh karne walon mein se na hote, to qayamat ke din tak usi machli ke pet mein rehte.

say.en: He was cast onto a bare shore, and he was ill. And Allah made a gourd plant grow over him.
say.hi: Unhein ek khuli veeran zameen par daal diya gaya, woh beemar the. Aur Allah ne unpar ek bail daar paudha uga diya.

say.en: He was sent to a hundred thousand or more. And they believed, so Allah let them enjoy life for a time.
say.hi: Unhein ek laakh ya usse zyada logon ki taraf bheja gaya. Woh imaan laaye, to Allah ne unhein ek waqt tak zindagi ka faida diya.

heading.en: THE ONLY TOWN | *SAVED BY ITS FAITH*
heading.hi: WOH AKELI BASTI | *JISE IMAAN NE BACHAYA*

say.en: The Quran tells us that the people of Yunus were the only town whose faith benefited them when the punishment came near.
say.hi: Quran batata hai ke Yunus ki qaum woh akeli basti thi, jiska imaan azaab ke qareeb aakar bhi uske kaam aaya.

say.en: And the Prophet, peace be upon him, said: None should say that I am better than Yunus bin Matta.
say.hi: Aur Nabi sallallahu alaihi wasallam ne farmaya: koi yeh na kahe ke main Yunus bin Matta se behtar hoon.

say.en: So when your life gets dark, call Him the way Yunus did. He heard Yunus from the belly of a fish. He hears you.
say.hi: To jab aapki zindagi mein andhera ho, Usay waise hi pukaarna jaise Yunus ne pukaara. Usne machli ke pet se Yunus ki suni. Woh aapki bhi sunta hai.

heading.en: SEND THIS TO SOMEONE | *IN THE DARK TODAY*
heading.hi: YEH USAY BHEJEIN | *JO AAJ ANDHERE MEIN HAI*

say.en: Send this to someone who is going through darkness today.
say.hi: Yeh video usay bhejein, jo aaj kisi andhere se guzar raha hai.
